chapter: Postwar: Chicago, Vinson, Hines and Cootie
title: Poker with the Ink Spots
summary: Everyone gambled on the bus; he nearly broke Kenny of the Ink Spots in Seattle but lost his nerve.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Because we all used to gamble in the band, playing poker.
Like, travelling in the bus and everything.
Kenny, he -- oh, he loved to play
And we were playing poker every night.
Oh, I lost, but I got mine back. When I get mine back, I quit. I'm chicken.
Well, after you've it makes you think... I'd feel lost (Inaudible)
But one time there, I had Kenny down to his last dollar. That's right.
That was in Seattle, Washington. I never will forget that, gee.
Everybody was talking about that, I guess.
Well, I got chicken again and wouldn't bet him on that last hand. And I had him beat. Had him beat. I'd have of broke him, too. Sure would have. Gee.
Yeah, well, when it gets real --
Well, I was young and in the game, anyway, see. And I was chicken. They'd been playing longer than I had.
